events.text: An4ouS_ has made peace with Ygurec!

The Maya have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Patron of Weavers (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each [ICON_RES_SILK] Silk, Dye, and [ICON_RES_COTTON] Cotton resource)

Carthage has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Seafood Rituals (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from each source of [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crabs, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CAVIAR] Black Caviar and [ICON_RES_REDCAVIAR] Red Caviar. +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from each source of [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish)
Russia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of the Hunt (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food from Camps)

Byzantium has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

Brazil has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)
An4ouS_ has made peace with Anoriel22!

Babylon has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Monument to the Gods (+20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production of Ancient/Classical/Medieval Wonders. Ancient/Classical/Medieval Wonders (except National Wonders) provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] happiness)
A golden age begins for the Babylonian civilization.

The Maya have founded the new religion Judaism in the holy city of Palenque:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Church Property[ENDCOLOR] +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each city following this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Monasteries[ENDCOLOR] Use [ICON_PEACE] Faith to purchase Monasteries (+2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture)[NEWLINE][ICON_PEACE] Faith cost on Quick speed: Monastery 130.
A golden age begins for the Mayan civilization.

Carthage has founded the new religion Catholicism in the holy city of Carthage:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pilgrimage[ENDCOLOR] +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith for each city following this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Hawk Spirit[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_AQUEDUCT] Aqueducts provide +5 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food.

Byzantium has founded the new religion Eastern Orthodoxy in the holy city of Constantinople:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Tithe[ENDCOLOR] +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every 4 followers of this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Devout Performers[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_COLOSSEUM] Colosseums provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. [ICON_BUILDING_CIRCUS] Circuses provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. [ICON_BUILDING_CIRCUS_MAXIMUS] Circus Maximus provides +5 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness in city and +4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture.[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Disciples[ENDCOLOR] +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from every tile improvement built by a Great Person (Academy, Customs House, Manufactory, Citadel, Holy Site, Admiralty, Concert).
A golden age begins for the Carthaginian civilization.

Brazil has founded the new religion Protestantism in the holy city of Rio de Janeiro:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Peace Loving[ENDCOLOR] +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Global Happiness for every 12 followers of this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Blessed Recruits[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_BARRACKS] Barracks provide +1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Units trained in a city with [ICON_BUILDING_BARRACKS] Barracks receive +10 XP.

Russia has founded the new religion Buddhism in the holy city of Moscow:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Sacred Capital[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +4 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Choral Music[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_TEMPLE] Temples provide +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture.
